scope: Host C++ fixture extracts and compiles the exact production comms.cpp slice from namespace aph::comms through immediately before void bag(int gems), with explicit thin mocks for World, shared memory, visible records, support mailbox, and champion observations. It exercises production functions, not a reimplemented policy.

limitations: Host mocks do not execute the WASI/native SDK or actual engine turn scheduling.
Source extraction compiles exact production functions but caller-side dispatch and native shared-memory behavior are outside this fixture.
The fixture validates protocol mechanics under explicit observations; it does not measure match strength or runtime cost.
